headline_seed: 'El Chapo Isidro': Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out - BBC
draft_text:
Mexican forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores — "El Chapo Isidro" — in Guasave, Sinaloa. 11 dead in the operation: 7 cartel gunmen, 4 soldiers. The LA Times and ABC News both report the FBI had offered $5M for his arrest.

And that's the mews.
